info.bio:
Highly unorthodox Chicago -> N.Y. noise-rock group, active in the 1980s and early '90s, initially known as Bag People. Members/contributors included Algis Kizys (ex-Swans, Foetus (live), Glenn Branca), Ted Parsons (ex-Swans, Prong, Godflesh, Jesu), Carolyn Master, Diane Wlezien, Rich Hutchins (ex-Live Skull) and Vinnie Signorelli (ex-Swans, Foetus, Unsane, Lubricated Goat).


Major discography:

Of Cabbages and Kings -  EP - 1987
Face - EP - 1988

scenes.name: Noise-rock y noise-pop
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Sonic Youth acuñan el «noise-rock»: aún obedece las reglas del rock'n'roll, pero secuestrado por sonidos disonantes. En Nueva York, Rat At Rat R, Agitpop, Ritual Tension, Gut Bank, la triple guitarra de Band Of Susans, Of Cabbages And Kings, Spongehead, Alice Donut. Boston da los grupos más influyentes de la década siguiente: Dinosaur Jr (el estándar «noise-pop», fusión de distorsión y melodía, eslabón entre Sonic Youth y el grunge) y los Pixies (Surfer Rosa, Doolittle). El art-punk del Sur (Antietam, Squirrel Bait, Blind Idiot God, Alter Natives) y los excéntricos de San Francisco (Tragic Mulatto, Slovenly).

mentions.author: Piero Scaruffi
mentions.text: …the guitars and polishing the melodies. The False Virgins' Skinjob (1989) was representative of the flood of Sonic Youth imitators to come. Of Cabbages And Kings (2) were masters of the dramatic tension, thanks to an eclectic fusion that reached out to hardcore as well as to jazz. The EP Of Cabbages And Kings (1988) and the mini-album Face (1988) were still reminiscent of their roots (Swans, Foetus, Glenn Branca), but an original and unpredictable style…
